instruction: Open or import the initial CAD geometry file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\thread_plate.step. Drill and thread mill the six M8 pilot holes in C:\Users\User\Desktop\thread_plate.step. Thread Milling must reach Z=0.000 mm and include arcs or a helical approximation. Tool definitions: T1 is a 6.8 mm drill for M8 pilot holes; T2 is an M8 thread mill. Use the Manufacturing setup, MCS, blank/stock, tool, operation, toolpath verification, and post-processing dialogs as needed. Post or save the required NC/G-code output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-18.nc.
